data.name: Rainy Day Bookshop
data.shortDescription: A cozy bookshop where it always seems to be raining. Sort books, recommend the right one to each visitor and rearrange the shelves.

cardImage.alt: A customer browsing a book in a cozy secondhand bookshop while chatting with the shopkeeper across the counter, with warm lamps, bookshelves and a sleeping cat

data.name: Pebble Stack
data.shortDescription: Stack pebbles into tall wobbly towers. Pick the right stone, find the balance point and try not to sneeze.

cardImage.alt: Hands carefully balancing smooth stones into a tall stack above a mossy rock in a shallow stream

data.name: Drum Circle Dash
data.shortDescription: A fast rhythm game with hand drums. Hit the right pad at the right time and keep the circle going as the tempo ramps up.

cardImage.alt: A rhythm game featuring drummers playing glowing hand drums at a lively outdoor festival, with musical notes, lanterns and rhythm-based game modes

data.name: Jelly Jump
data.shortDescription: Bounce a little jelly up a tower of floating platforms. Time your jumps, collect sweets and try not to land on the sour ones.

cardImage.alt: A pink jelly character bouncing between colorful candy-shaped platforms in a bright pastel sky, surrounded by floating sweets
